 Orlando Magic Golden State Warriors Thursday night in the NBA is the calm before the storm of NBA Cup games on Friday, as only four teams are in action.

 This week has been an anomaly in the NBA schedule, as Election Day on Tuesday led to 15 NBA games on Monday night and 14 on Wednesday, setting up a lopsided day of action on Nov. 5. 
--> This week has been an anomaly in the NBA schedule, as Election Day on Tuesday led to 15 NBA games on Monday night and 14 on Wednesday, setting up a lopsided day of action on Nov. 5. 
 Still, we’ve seen some awesome performances, including one that altered the NBA MVP odds this season. 
--> Still, we’ve seen some awesome performances, including one that altered the NBA MVP odds this season. 
 Dew’s Review: Victor Wembanyama stole the show in a 14-game slate on Wednesday night, dropping 52 points, 24 rebounds and eight blocks – the first 50-point, 20-rebound, five-block game game since 1974 – in a one-point win over the Dallas Mavericks. He’s now the favorite to win the NBA MVP this season , taking a slight lead over Los Angeles Lakers star Luka Doncic, who had another 40-point game on Wednesday in a win over the Sacramento Kings. The NBA MVP race is shaping up to be a great one with five players set a 10/1 or better through the first two-plus weeks of the season. Still, Wemby – the preseason favorite – holds a slight edge because of his elite play on both ends of the floor.

 When it comes to Thursday’s action, I’m eyeing a pair of bets, including one for the Golden State Warriors, who are one of the hottest teams in the league. 
--> When it comes to Thursday’s action, I’m eyeing a pair of bets, including one for the Golden State Warriors, who are one of the hottest teams in the league. 
 Peter’s Point: Can the Warriors make it six wins in a row on Thursday night? Golden State looked dead in the water to open the season, going 0-3, but it’s won five games in a row and the play of rookie Yaxel Lendeborg may have extended the Steph Curry era. Curry is averaging 30.0 points per game this season, and the Warriors are favored at home against a Miami Heat team that needed overtime to beat the Los Angeles Clippers on Wednesday night.

 Orlando Magic +10.5 vs. Phoenix Suns 
--> Orlando Magic +10.5 vs. Phoenix Suns 
 The Suns are off to an awful start in the 2026-27 season, losing to Portland on Wednesday to drop to 1-5. 
--> The Suns are off to an awful start in the 2026-27 season, losing to Portland on Wednesday to drop to 1-5. 
 So far this season, the Suns rank 30th in defensive rating and 25th in net rating, and they’re really missed starting center Mark Williams down low. There’s a chance the Suns could be short-handed on the second night of a back-to-back, so I don’t want to take them as favorites – even against the two-win Magic.

 The injury bug has once again crushed Orlando with Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs sidelined, and the Magic rank in the bottom 10 in the league in both offensive and defensive rating.

 Yet, I think they’re equipped to beat a Suns team that hasn’t been able to stop anyone and has just one win (against the Steph Curry-less Warriors) in the 2026-27 season.
